pull.title: BIP-0322: name taproot upgrade mechanisms in the upgradeable rules
pull.body:
BIP322's upgradeable rules do not name four taproot upgrade mechanisms, so a verifier that follows the text calls a signature using one of them valid. This adds one rule naming them: an unknown leaf version and the annex (BIP341), OP_SUCCESSx and an unknown public key type (BIP342). Such a signature then gets the inconclusive state, as reserved NOPs and segwit versions above 1 already do. The version becomes 2.1.0, as requested in review.

The BIP322 library in [btcd#2521](https://github.com/btcsuite/btcd/pull/2521) already returns inconclusive for all four, and the gap was raised in its [review](https://github.com/btcsuite/btcd/pull/2521#discussion_r3343915648). I ran its test vectors through btclib-wallet, a verifier I maintain: it agreed on three of the four and called the annex case valid, as the current text says.

cc @guggero @kallewoof

tree baa637b4bc4ab9b8382e1719fae1e71def89350f
parent c0c5aea41e6a334d34db4ca87ae53bbfd7f268d1
author Ferdinando Ametrano <ferdinando@ametrano.net> 1792729107 +0200
committer Ferdinando Ametrano <ferdinando@ametrano.net> 1792767938 +0200

BIP-0322: name taproot upgrade mechanisms in the upgradeable rules

The upgradeable rules list the to_sign version, NOPs reserved for
upgrades and segwit versions above 1. BIP341 and BIP342 also reserve
unknown leaf versions, OP_SUCCESSx, unknown public key types and the
annex for upgrades. A verifier that follows the BIP322 text calls a
signature using any of them valid. Name them, so that these give the
inconclusive state like the other upgrade mechanisms.

Bump the version to 2.1.0 and add a changelog entry.
Add 342 to Requires.

comments.body:
IMHO we could go with a minor version change here.
From BIP3:

> The MINOR version is incremented whenever the specification of the BIP is changed or extended in a backward-compatible way.

The clarified taproot rules are themselves called "upgrade mechanisms", which, in the spirit of the spec as written, would implicitly fall into the `upgradeable rules` category.
This clarification just makes the rules explicit to avoid confusion.

I will add/update the test vectors of BIP322 once the [Golang implementation](https://github.com/btcsuite/btcd/pull/2521) is finalized/merged. That implementation and vectors also share the current interpretation that this change turns into explicit rules.

But, since this is more about the BIP process than the content, I'm deferring to the maintainers' opinion (cc @murchandamus, @jonatack) here.
